description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core middleware class ErrorHandlingMiddleware that intercepts HTTP requests, handles exceptions, logs errors, and returns JSON error responses based on exception types.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: ASP.NET Core middleware for centralized error handling, logging, and response formatting.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Entry point for middleware that executes the next request delegate and catches exceptions to handle errors.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by setting appropriate HTTP status codes and returning serialized JSON error responses.
